test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b84667975e34d9e96a51e137e7a68fb132ffa0c1b8a8c946f200016b225d228d.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 'P' element → Shifting in the forward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e46ba485e204ee79340d2350e6ef304b6a66427911440864a5c306f935ac616a.png] 

2) For 'E' element → → Shifting in the forward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ede4fb7e0337b9fd5e80b0bc3f3258b6315794efee790fde0c94d43dfec9bd2.png] 

3) For 'N' element → Shifting in the forward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42c8668b47f9739488f2d3525fd9d44772f0e8b9bf928d02851b4f73401b089c.png] 

4) For 'C' element → Shifting in the forward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58f1b2b3b02352114140891427812ba8256215477b760ba1e711575c91e10ac6.png] 

5) For 'I' element → Shifting in the forward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/001d537999e43880a46e0cb533f00d462509bc7909898115e385206a6c2e152e.png] 

6) For 'L' element → Shifting diagonally and then diagonally in downward direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f35d847f4f4cb61b4a132e9eead6d7186d52c69becdac20f484baf712ed49a4.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e2e2ab0a3cd2036614809ddc10de256cfde51b7c2ba21cdab8c8c1f8b358f8.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
